### He Has Set Eternity in Our Hearts (Ecclesiastes 3:11) - Your Daily Bible Verse - March 9
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-march-9.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:11
Points:
- Unlike the rest of creation, humans are uniquely aware of their mortality and troubled by it.
- God placed eternity in human hearts, creating an innate longing for life beyond our earthly span.
- Without an eternal perspective, mortal life feels incomplete and meaningless.
- Eternal life begins now through faith in Jesus Christ and extends beyond physical death.
- Believers can face mortality with peace by resting in God's gift of grace and salvation.

### God Doesn’t Work by Coincidence - Encouragement for Today - February 7, 2023
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-7-2023.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:11
Points:
- The timing of significant life events is not accidental, because God governs time itself.
- God divinely orchestrates circumstances behind the scenes according to His sovereign plan.
- Past pain, grief, and heartbreak can be transformed into healing and new purpose in God’s time.
- Stepping past fear and insecurity becomes possible when we trust God's intentional timeline.
- Reflecting on how God aligns our life milestones strengthens our trust in His sovereignty.
